title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Deepening the Education of Socialist Rule of Law Concepts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Deepening Education on the Socialist Rule of Law Concept

Fa Fa [2006] No. 24

To: The Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Recently, the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission convened a teleconference on "Deepening Education on the Socialist Rule of Law Concept." Comrade Luo Gan delivered an important speech at the conference, fully affirming the achievements of political and legal organs nationwide in conducting education on the socialist rule of law concept, clearly pointing out the existing gaps in the work, and setting forth specific requirements for the next stage of deepening education on the socialist rule of law concept. Based on the education situation in various localities, the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission decided to extend the centralized education phase to the first half of next year and required political and legal organs at all levels to re-mobilize and redeploy for this work.

In accordance with this requirement of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission and in light of the actual work of the courts, the following notice is hereby issued on how to deepen education on the socialist rule of law concept:

I. Further Enhance Understanding, and Continue to Thoroughly Pursue Study, Discussion, and Practical Activities

Since the launch of the education campaign on the socialist rule of law concept, the Party groups of people's courts at all levels have generally attached importance to it, and the education campaign has achieved certain results. However, the progress of the campaign has been uneven. In some courts, the understanding of this education is not yet deep enough, the work is not yet solid enough, and the connection with reality is not yet close enough; these phenomena objectively exist. At the same time, the transformation of ideological concepts and the formation of behavioral habits are not matters that can be accomplished overnight; they require a process of continuous improvement and gradual deepening. Therefore, the decision of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission to extend the centralized education phase to consolidate and deepen the dominant position of the socialist rule of law concept in judicial thinking is very necessary.

People's courts at all levels should earnestly comprehend this requirement, further adjust their work deployment, and from now until the first quarter of next year, combine the study of the "Selected Works of Jiang Zemin" and the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session [of the Sixteenth CPC Central Committee] to continue to deeply pursue study, discussion, and practical activities. In the second quarter of next year, they should earnestly conduct assessment and summary work.

In response to possible fatigue and slack thinking, the Party groups of people's courts at all levels should first unify their ideological understanding, objectively analyze the achievements and shortcomings of the education campaign in the previous stage, fully understand the significance of the extension of the centralized education phase by the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, formulate a good implementation plan for the next stage of deepening education, and continue to carry out this activity solidly with a highly responsible spirit, so that the socialist rule of law concept becomes more deeply rooted in the people's hearts. On this basis, re-mobilization should be carried out among judges and their staff, explaining the necessity of extending the education period, clarifying any vague understandings, and continuously enhancing their consciousness in establishing and practicing the socialist rule of law concept.

II. Focus on Deeply Studying the "Selected Works of Jiang Zemin" and Studying and Implementing the Spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session to Deepen Education on the Socialist Rule of Law Concept

The "Selected Works of Jiang Zemin" vividly records the historical process by which the third generation of the Party's central collective leadership, with Comrade Jiang Zemin at its core, led the entire Party and people of all ethnic groups across the country to advance the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics. It scientifically summarizes the valuable experience of our Party leading the people in overcoming various difficulties and dangers and comprehensively creating a new situation in the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics. It centrally reflects the major new theoretical achievements creatively put forward by our Party in adhering to the combination of the basic principles of Marxism with contemporary Chinese practice and the characteristics of the times. It provides the best textbook for consolidating and strengthening the common ideological foundation for the united struggle of the entire Party and people of all ethnic groups across the country. Recently, the Supreme People's Court, in accordance with the spirit of the Central Committee, has issued a notice requiring people's courts at all levels to treat the in-depth study of the "Selected Works of Jiang Zemin" as an important political task for the current period and the future.

People's courts at all levels should, in accordance with the spirit of Comrade Luo Gan's speech at the national teleconference and the requirements of this notice, integrate education on the socialist rule of law concept with the study of the "Selected Works of Jiang Zemin." In particular, they must deeply comprehend Comrade Jiang Zemin's thoughts on unswervingly adhering to the Four Cardinal Principles; on correctly handling the relationship among reform, development, and stability; on strengthening socialist legal system construction, adhering to the rule of law, and combining the rule of law with the rule of virtue; on realizing, safeguarding, and developing the fundamental interests of the broadest majority of the people; on ensuring that the Party's absolute leadership over the people's democratic dictatorship organs cannot be shaken at any time; on promoting judicial system reform to ensure fairness and justice in the whole society; on adopting a combination of crackdown and prevention to solve social security problems, including severely cracking down on criminal offenses according to law while adhering to the mass line, focusing efforts at the grassroots level, and strengthening comprehensive governance; and on strictly managing the police force, comprehensively improving the political and professional quality of political and legal cadres, and strengthening judicial guarantees, etc. The "Three Represents" important thought should be used to guide education on the socialist rule of law concept, truly ensuring that correct ideas are upheld, erroneous ideas are corrected, and concepts that are not suited to the requirements of the new situation are updated.

Deepening education on the socialist rule of law concept must also be combined with the study and implementation of the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session of the Sixteenth CPC Central Committee. By earnestly studying and comprehending General Secretary Hu Jintao's important speech at the plenary session and the "Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Several Major Issues Concerning the Construction of a Socialist Harmonious Society," judges and their staff should be guided to deeply understand that social harmony is an essential attribute of socialism with Chinese characteristics, to clearly understand that building a socialist harmonious society is an inherent requirement for building a modern socialist country that is prosperous, strong, democratic, culturally advanced, and harmonious, and to enhance their sense of responsibility and urgency in building a harmonious society; to deeply understand the major strategic deployments made by the Party Central Committee for building a socialist harmonious society, to clearly understand the guiding ideology, goals and tasks, principles and policies, and strategic priorities for building a socialist harmonious society, to enhance their awareness of the overall situation and service awareness, to fully exercise their adjudicative functions, and to strengthen and deepen the socialist rule of law concept in the practice of providing strong judicial guarantees for a socialist harmonious society.

In terms of specific arrangements, the study of the "Selected Works of Jiang Zemin" and the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session of the Sixteenth CPC Central Committee should be incorporated into the study plans of the theoretical study centers of people's courts at all levels, into the education and training plans for Party members and cadres at the division level and above, as well as for judges and their staff, and into the regular education of Party members. Study should be linked to reality, focusing on results, and aimed at ideological armament and work promotion.

III. Closely Link with Reality, Deepen Education on the Socialist Rule of Law Concept in the Course of Advancing Court Work

Only when education on the socialist rule of law concept is integrated with judicial practice can it be continuously strengthened, become deeply rooted in people's hearts, and achieve results without becoming a mere formality. Therefore, people's courts at all levels must insist on carrying out the advancement of work throughout the entire education campaign.

First, guided by the socialist rule of law concept, push the standardization of judicial conduct to a new stage. According to the deployment of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, the standardization construction is for a period of three years, and the tasks ahead are still very heavy. To ensure practical results, it is necessary to grasp key points and adopt effective measures. 1. By referring to the requirements of the socialist rule of law concept, focus on prominent issues in judicial work and typical cases for deep reflection. Analyze cases of illegal case handling, perfunctory and passive inaction, handling cases based on personal connections or favoritism, handling cases mechanically without considering the overall situation or the unity of legal and social effects, identify the root ideological causes, and understand the harm. Consciously use the socialist rule of law concept to guide, standardize, and evaluate judicial work, reducing the occurrence of problems such as unfair, unrigorous, uncivilized, and inactive judicial conduct. 2. Address issues that are strongly reflected by the people. Currently, the focus remains on properly solving problems such as litigation-related petitions, "difficulty in appeals," "difficulty in applying for retrials," and "difficulty in enforcement." These are important criteria for testing the effectiveness of the education campaign. People's courts at all levels should closely integrate education on the socialist rule of law concept with solving these difficult problems. Through solving these problems, provide vivid education on the socialist rule of law concept for judges and their staff; promote the resolution of problems by correcting the guiding ideology for judicial work, and advance standardization construction. 3. Strengthen the construction of long-term mechanisms. In accordance with the requirements of the socialist rule of law concept, such as justice for the people, focus on building the law enforcement responsibility system, the law enforcement supervision system, the judicial informatization system, and the education and training system, incorporating the essential connotations and basic requirements of the socialist rule of law concept into long-term mechanisms for standardizing law enforcement conduct.

Second, guided by the socialist rule of law concept, do a good job in all adjudication and enforcement work to promote peace and security construction. People's courts at all levels should fully exercise their adjudicative functions and regard maintaining social harmony and stability as their primary responsibility. They must correctly implement the criminal policy of "combining leniency with severity." While adhering to the policy of "striking hard" and severely punishing, according to law, all crimes that seriously endanger social order, the economic order, and the safety of people's lives and property, they must also insist on "giving a way out" to offenders whose circumstances are relatively minor and who genuinely show repentance, actively educate, influence, and save juvenile offenders, and minimize social confrontation to the greatest extent possible. They should vigorously promote judicial mediation, increase the intensity and scope of mediation in civil and commercial cases, vigorously implement the conciliation system in enforcement, actively explore new ideas for the coordinated resolution of administrative cases, and actively try new models for the mediation and resolution of minor criminal cases and criminal private prosecution cases. Strive to resolve cases so that the case is concluded, both parties accept the judgment, disputes are settled, and all types of social conflicts are minimized. Actively and steadily carry out enforcement work, ensuring enforcement intensity, striving to realize effective judgments, maintaining legal authority and the socio-economic order determined by law, while also ensuring civilized and standardized enforcement, avoiding negative effects and impacts caused by chaotic or improper enforcement. Do a good job in handling petitions and retrials, insist on correcting mistakes whenever found, solve difficulties for the people, and reduce factors of social instability. Earnestly implement various measures to facilitate litigation for the people, increase the intensity of judicial aid, and ensure effective protection for vulnerable groups. At the same time, fully utilize means such as judicial suggestions, legal publicity, and education to actively participate in the comprehensive governance of social order.

Third, guided by the socialist rule of law concept, advance the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms. Correctly understand China's judicial system, earnestly learn from the achievements of foreign rule of law civilization, while insisting on proceeding from China's national conditions, ensuring the Party's leadership and the socialist direction. Closely focus on achieving the themes of "justice and efficiency" and "justice for the people," grasp the issues with which the people are dissatisfied, carry out reform and innovation, strive to resolve the contradiction between the people's growing judicial needs and the inadequacy of the people's court system, and safeguard and realize the fundamental interests of the people. At the same time, increase the transparency of court work, facilitate the people's supervision of judicial power, effectively prevent the occurrence of problems such as illegal use of power, law enforcement violating the law, and bending the law for personal gain, and ensure the correct implementation of national laws.

IV. Strengthen Leadership, Carry Through to the End, and Ensure the Education Campaign Achieves Practical Results

Deepening education on the socialist rule of law concept not only means an extension of time but also a deepening of content. People's courts at all levels should attach high importance, ensure the education campaign starts well and ends well with higher standards and more proactive measures.

First, leading cadres should play an exemplary role. They should take the lead in studying, publicizing, rectifying, and practicing, inspiring and driving the masses with a positive attitude and actions. At the same time, fully utilize forms such as lectures, seminars, and contact points to do a good job in publicity and education, using their own theoretical clarity to enlighten and influence the masses.

Second, use pilot sites to drive overall progress. Each Higher People's Court should conduct in-depth investigation and research, earnestly summarize the experiences of grassroots courts in conducting education on the socialist rule of law concept and standardizing judicial conduct, and cultivate and establish "demonstration units" and "demonstration posts" for standardized judicial conduct in various judicial fields and at various levels. This should be combined with selection and commendation work to discover, establish, and publicize a group of advanced models that fully embody the socialist rule of law concept, characterized by civilized and standardized judicial work. The Supreme People's Court will hold a National Conference on Court Team Building and a Seminar on the Socialist Rule of Law Concept early next year and will, at an appropriate time, organize a nationwide tour to report on the deeds of model judges.

Third, do a good job in summary and inspection. Based on the knowledge assessment of judges and their staff on the socialist rule of law concept, in the second quarter of next year, each Higher People's Court should organize a good summary and inspection of the education campaign on the socialist rule of law concept. The focus of the inspection should be on whether correct concepts have been established, whether erroneous ideas have been clarified, whether outdated concepts have been updated, whether issues strongly reflected by the people have been effectively resolved, whether trial quality and efficiency have been further improved, and whether standardization construction has achieved practical results. The Supreme People's Court will also send inspection teams to conduct spot checks on the education campaign in courts in various localities.

October 18, 2006
